decisions.executionNote: Begin left-side tube approach, raising and pitching the open gripper while maintaining elbow-up continuity.
Advance toward the leftmost tube with a near-downward grasp orientation; remaining alignment will use the wrist image.
Finish aligning above the tube body and descend to grasp height, keeping the gripper open.
Center the body between the fingers, close completely, and begin a small lift to check retention.
Lift the retained tube clear of the table, then begin rotating it upright toward the rack.
Carry the first tube toward the left rack slots while progressively turning its axis vertical.
Complete the upright orientation over the rack's left side, retaining clearance above the top plate.
Align with the left-front large slot and lower the upright tube cautiously toward the rack opening.
Continue the slow vertical insertion of the first tube, watching for contact or lateral displacement.
Release the first tube at insertion depth and withdraw the open fingers without disturbing the rack.
First tube appears upright and released. Retract the left arm while beginning a raised right-arm approach to the rightmost tube.
Advance the right gripper above the tube with a downward approach; continue the left arm's gradual return.
Finish the right tube's downward alignment and approach grasp height, with the left arm settled near origin.
Correct the right tube's axial alignment, close the fingers, and make a small retention-check lift.
Lift the second tube away from the table, then start rotating it upright toward a right-side rack slot.
Carry the retained right tube toward the rack and rotate it upward, staying in the right workspace.
Complete the upright orientation and position the second tube above the right-front rack slot.
Lower the upright second tube toward the right slot with a small lateral centering correction.
Insert the second tube vertically to the rack depth while maintaining the closed grasp.
The tube appears to have met the slot rim and slid upward. Lift slightly and shift inward before retrying insertion.
Retry the vertical insertion after the inward alignment correction; keep the tube closed until seating is visible.
Release the aligned second tube to let it settle into the slot, then withdraw slightly and check the seating visually.
Two tubes appear seated and released. Begin the left-arm approach to the remaining tube while retracting the right arm.
Advance the left gripper above the final tube with a downward grasp orientation, while continuing the right arm's return.
Align the remaining tube between the left fingers and lower to grasp height; settle the right arm at origin.
Center the grasp slightly closer to the cap, close around the last tube, and lift minimally to verify retention.
Lift the final tube clear and start rotating it upright, keeping clearance from the two seated tubes.
Rotate the final tube toward vertical at a raised height, holding it forward of the already seated tubes.
Finish rotating the last tube upright above the center-front slot, keeping its tip above the neighboring caps.
Lower the upright final tube toward the center opening, retaining clearance from the two inserted tubes.
Insert the final tube slowly into the center slot, monitoring for rim contact or slipping.
Seat and release the last tube, then begin withdrawing the open gripper to confirm that all three remain upright.
All three tubes appear released in the rack. Withdraw the left arm upward and backward, beginning the return to origin.
